rapport_notes: Excellent — patient, detailed, and reassuring through a long, complex long-distance partial move with lots of customer questions.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked formally, but customer raised a genuine worry late in the call about the long drive/overnight logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Rep thoroughly explained the one-day vs. two-day scenario and the overnight-hotel contingency until the customer said 'that was more of just I was curious... okay perfect.'
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'We do not require any deposit... anything changes you can let us know and we can reschedule you anytime' — reassuring but not the scripted 'estimate is a window' or 'beats it pay less' lines.

top_strength: Walked a nervous long-distance mover through the full one-day-vs-two-day loading/driving/unloading logistics clearly enough that she said it resolved her worry completely.
coaching_note: A genuinely strong discovery call — layering in the specific damage-coverage ($2,000) language for the antique mirror and weight machine would have made an already-good call excellent.
